correctness.rationale: For a connected nonnegative symmetric weighted three-node Laplacian, verified the characteristic equation L^3-2sL^2+3tau L=0 (tau=ab+ac+bc>0), the exact [2/2] Padé quotient, its positive rational denominator D and the off-diagonal numerator 4h[12w+6tau h+tau(2s-3w)h^2]. The sign polynomial has no positive zero if 3w<=2s, otherwise exactly one at H=(3+sqrt(9+12w(3w-2s)/tau))/(3w-2s); at most one edge is exceptional. The scalar stability function r(z)=(z²-6z+12)/(z²+6z+12) lies (0,1] for z>=0, yielding positive diagonals, row/column sums 1, and spectral stability. The pseudoinverse formula L+_ij=(3w-2s)/(9tau) gives the equivalent Green criterion and large-step sign. Direct independently written SymPy rational matrix quotients matched 36 test cases, including zero-weight paths; the algebraic argument handles all h>=0 and all real conductances, unlike the tests.

value.rationale: A sharp, nonreentrant timestep positivity horizon for every three-vertex symmetric weighted diffusion network is a meaningful minimal-dimensional positivity classification, distinguishing spectral stability from cone preservation. Exact conductance criterion, Green-kernel reformulation, boundary at weight ratio 2 for paths, and extremal three-site onset are genuinely interpretable numerical properties, not a relabeled broad method theorem.
